weights.open_clip_init: FrozenOpenCLIPImageEmbedder is built with pretrained=None (no laion2b_s32b_b79k download): every one of its tensors is in vista.safetensors and overwrites the initialisation; the adapter refuses to run unless load_state_dict reports no missing and no unexpected key

released_defaults.source: sample.py argparse defaults and main loop, sample_utils.py (init_sampling, get_guider, get_sampler, init_embedder_options, do_sample), configs/inference/vista.yaml, docs/SAMPLING.md
released_defaults.guider_multi_round: TrianglePredictionGuider(max_scale 2.5, min_scale 1.0, num_frames 25, period 1.0, period_fusing max)
released_defaults.rollout: round 1: the condition frame at index 0 (initial_cond_mask[0] = 1); rounds 2..: the last 3 latents of the previous round as condition frames 0-2 (prediction_cond_mask[0, 1, 2] = 1), the CLIP image of the third-last decoded frame, 22 new frames per round; total latents num_rounds x 22 + 3
released_defaults.decode: decode_first_stage: 14-latent windows with a 3-latent overlap averaged, fp32 (disable_first_stage_autocast)
released_defaults.encode: encode_first_stage: chunks of 14 frames, DiagonalGaussianRegularizer posterior sample (CPU generator), x scale_factor 0.18215
released_defaults.low_vram: --low_vram ('if you are using a GPU with less than 80 GB VRAM'): UNet weights in fp16, each sub-model moved to the GPU only while used
released_defaults.input_image: load_img: centre crop to 16:9, PIL LANCZOS resize to 1024 x 576, ToTensor, x * 2 - 1
released_defaults.output_image: clamp((x + 1) / 2, 0, 1), then perform_save_locally: (255.0 * x).astype(np.uint8) (truncation), mp4 at 10 fps

action_modes.trajectory: traj[2:]: 4 waypoints (x right, y forward) in metres, flattened to 8 numbers

tracks.h0: T1-H0: the anchor frame only, action-free (the released default 'free' mode: the action embeddings are zero)
tracks.t2: T2: the anchor frame plus the real future ego trajectory (mode trajectory), one action per rollout round

320x576.canvas_mapping: cv2.INTER_AREA from 576 x 320 to the 512 x 288 canvas (run_vista_bench.inter_area: the generic area resampling of OpenCV, checked bit for bit against cv2 5.0.0 on every input frame)
320x576.note: the owner's decision of 2026-11-04 ~23:00: Vista generates at 320 x 576 (H x W), both multiples of 64, so the UNet code is not modified at all; below the 576 x 1024 training size. The bench band (1550 x 872, aspect 1.7775) is rendered directly to 576 x 320 (aspect 1.8: a vertical squeeze of 1.3 %); every output frame, the prefix and the reference are resized with INTER_AREA to the 512 x 288 canvas (disclosed)

canvas.canvas_mapping: identity: the official uint8 (truncation) frames of the 288 x 512 decode are the canvas
canvas.note: the owner's decision of 2026-11-04: every model of the benchmark generates at the 512 x 288 evaluation canvas (compute); for Vista below its 576 x 1024 training size (disclosed). The inputs are the bench renderer's own 512 x 288 frames of the band. Latent 36 x 64: the VideoUNet's one upsampling from 5 x 8 interpolates (nearest) to its 9 x 16 skip size (run_vista_bench.configure_size)

native.status: superseded 2026-11-04 (the first local DEV smoke and the paused T2 check; code snapshot vista-v1/superseded-576x1024/)

bench.clip_layout: vision.mp4 frame i = tick k = i - 20: frames 0-19 = the window's prefix (Vista VAE round trip of the real history frames k = -20..-1, seed_of(w, 'prefix'), shared by every clip of the window); frames 20-80 = the clip's own decode of latents 0-60 (k = 0..60): the generated rollout for h0 / t2, the real frames k = 0..60 through the same encode and decode for recon

trajectory_rule.frames: round n (0, 1, 2) covers rollout frames 22n .. 22n + 24; its 4 waypoints are frames 22n + 6i (i = 1..4), i.e. ticks k = 22n + 6i (t = 0.1 k s after t0): the frame-index alignment of Vista's nuScenes annotation (25 camera frames at 12 Hz, key frames 0, 6, 12, 18, 24 at 2 Hz)
trajectory_rule.reference_point_note: the point 0.94 m ahead of the AV2 rear axle: the nuScenes LIDAR_TOP lever arm (calibrated_sensor translation x 0.943713 m), whose positions Vista's annotation script (issue #30) uses
trajectory_rule.axes: x = right (= -y of the AV2 ego frame at the round's first frame), y = forward (= x - 0.94); metres
trajectory_rule.poses: AV2 city_SE3_egovehicle (devkit SE3), nearest pose to the camera frame of each tick (k <= 60: window.json ticks; k > 60: the nearest ring_front_center frame within 25 ms)
trajectory_rule.missing: a waypoint after the log's last pose is extrapolated at the constant speed and yaw rate of the last 1.0 s of ticks (flagged per window)

bench.seed_rule: seed_of(window, k) of make_bench_nano_specs.py (code snapshot orbis2-code-snapshot-v1, sha256 108c4cc9...968c): h0 and t2 sample k of a window share the seed; recon seed_of(w, 'recon'); prefix seed_of(w, 'prefix')

official.note: the released setting (no --low_vram): every sub-model resident in fp32, the UNet under autocast, the conditioner encodes the 25 condition copies at once; one sample per call (batching measured slower per sample). Peak by size: see min_gpu_memory_gb

local48.note: local 48 GB mechanics at the native size only (DEV smoke, DEV T2 scale check on the research server): --low_vram (UNet fp16) and the cond-frame encoder's chunking 1 (TF32 convolution numerics differ from the released batch-25 encode at about 1e-3); peak about 35 GiB allocated
